text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC."}],"comment":"The heat treatment is specified but the stage at which it applies (before or after machining, before or after plating) is not stated. Without a defined sequence the supplier cannot plan the process and risks dimensional distortion of finished features. The designer should add the manufacturing stage to the heat treatment callout in the title block or note N3.","recommended_correction":"Update the heat_treatment field or note N3 to state when toughening occurs relative to machining and surface treatment (e.g., 'TO BE TOUGHENED TO 24-32 HRC AFTER ROUGH MACHINING, BEFORE FINAL MACHINING AND PLATING')."}]}
